constraints: If appName is omitted, 4D first tries to interpret path as a file pathname and opens it with the most suitable application; in this case the '*' parameter is ignored.
If path is a standard URL (mailto:, news:, http:, etc.) and appName is omitted, 4D starts the default web browser to open it.
If appName is specified but no matching installed application is found, no error is returned and the command runs as if appName had not been specified.
Does not work when called from a Web process.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Opens the file or URL passed in path, using the application named in appName if specified (otherwise letting the system/default browser choose), optionally leaving the URL's special characters untranslated when '*' is passed.
